title: Test selection and repository workflow contracts

requirements.initial: The repository has root and package-local test commands.
requirements.action: Select an owner/risk boundary and inspect collection-wide triggers.
requirements.expected: Stable command scopes and hermetic default collection remain authoritative.

evidence.assertion: keeps root owner commands synchronized with the ownership map
evidence.scope: Manifest/config contract; does not execute all selected tests.

evidence.assertion: collects otherwise unrelated tests for metadata-only --changed edits
evidence.scope: Runs isolated Git/Vitest fixtures to verify actual changed-file collection after metadata edits; not a remote CI run.

evidence.assertion: assigns every repository spec to exactly one owner and one risk lane

requirements.gap: Invocation/config assertions alone do not prove actual remote CI or required branch protection.

requirements.initial: A candidate uses the intended branch/channel.
requirements.action: Evaluate workflow contracts and final artifact acceptance.
requirements.expected: Source and publication authority retain their existing boundaries.

evidence.scope: Static workflow checks; build/publication workflows are not executed by group discovery.

requirements.gap: Required local evidence runs in the existing source jobs; final artifact/platform gates and branch protection still require their own executed evidence.

requirements.initial: Actual Vitest reports can contain only skips, hook failures or omitted required assertions.
requirements.action: Inspect executed reports and run an immutable named gate.
requirements.expected: Only executed passing required assertions satisfy acceptance; missing, skipped, ambiguous or failed evidence blocks the gate.

evidence.assertion: rejects all-skipped, hook failure, nonzero and missing reports from real Vitest processes
evidence.scope: Runs actual isolated nested Vitest fixtures; no external side effects.

evidence.assertion: fails required evidence omitted or skipped despite other passing assertions
evidence.scope: Required row matching from actual normalized assertion statuses.

evidence.assertion: rejects attempts to narrow the required gate before execution
evidence.scope: Subprocess CLI dry-run/rejections; no native or external runner.
